fdroid:io.gitlab.cryptographic_id.name: Cryptographic ID
fdroid:io.gitlab.cryptographic_id.summary: Attest the trustworthiness of a device using asymmetric cryptography
fdroid:io.gitlab.cryptographic_id.description:
Use cases:
- Attest the state of a Linux computer
When your computer is in a trustworthy state, you can generate a private key hidden in the TPM2 of your computer. This private key can be sealed with the current state of the computer (PCRs). Then the computer can only sign a message with this key when it is in the correct state according to the PCRs. For example, you can seal the key against the secure boot state (PCR7). If your computer is booting an operating system signed by another vendor, the TPM2 cannot unseal the private key. So if your computer can generate a correct signature, it is in this known state. You can create a sealed private key and create such a signature with cryptographic-id-rs (https://gitlab.com/cryptographic_id/cryptographic-id-rs). This is similar to tpm2-totp (https://github.com/tpm2-software/tpm2-totp) but uses asymmetric cryptography. This means you do not need to keep the verification code secure. You can share it safely with the world.
- Verify the identity of a phone
You can generate a private key when your phone is in a trustworthy state. If your phone can create a correct signature, you know it is the same phone. Since the operating system can access the private key, the security guarantees are much weaker than with a TPM2. So the verification is just as secure as your phone. If you use Graphene OS, also have a look at Auditor (https://attestation.app/tutorial).
- Verify that a person is in possession of a private key
This works as well as the section above but has the same shortcomings. It can be used to verify someone in person when he sends his public key to you in advance over a secure channel.

firefox-addons:3003815.summary: See every tracker on every site in plain language. Block what you don't want. 100% local, open source.
firefox-addons:3003815.description:
See what's tracking you.
Stigma is a privacy extension that makes tracking visible, in plain language, and lets you do something about it. Open source, 100% local, honest about what it does and doesn't do.
WHAT STIGMA DOES
• Lists every tracker active on the page you are currently viewing
• Labels each one by company, product, category, and the specific types of data it collects
• Lets you block individual trackers or whole categories across every site
• Sends Global Privacy Control opt-out signals to sites that honor them
• Clears cookies and site data in one click
• Runs entirely in your browser. No accounts, no servers, no telemetry
WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
Most privacy tools pick a lane: block everything quietly, or explain everything at length. Stigma does neither. It shows you exactly what's happening, in language you can read, and lets you decide.
• Blocks tracking, not ads. When you block advertising trackers, some ads may fail to load as a side effect, but Stigma doesn't hide empty slots. For a full ad-free experience, pair it with a dedicated ad blocker.
• Plain language, not jargon. No "fingerprinting vectors" or "cross-domain request surfaces." Stigma describes what companies are doing in words you don't have to translate.
• Honest about limits. No tool can delete data companies already have or claw back profiles that brokers have already sold. What Stigma does is make today's tracking visible and stop new collection from piling on.
PRIVACY
Stigma collects no user data. No accounts, no servers, no telemetry. The extension runs entirely in your browser, ships with its tracker database built in, and does not communicate with any external service during normal operation. The full source code is public on GitHub, and you are welcome to audit it.
Full privacy policy: https://stigma.usual.systems/privacy
OPEN SOURCE
Stigma is licensed under GPL v3. The code is public at github.com/cpugs/stigma . Read it, audit it, or build your own copy.
BUILT BY USUAL SYSTEMS
Stigma is made by Usual Systems, an independent studio building transparent, useful tools. Learn more at usual.systems.

firefox-addons:3047214.description:
The wishlist made for window shopping, with price drop alerts built in.
WindowShoppings keeps everything you find while window shopping online in one place. Save products from almost any online store with one click, sort them into wishlists, share them with friends and family, and let WindowShoppings watch the prices so you buy at the right time.
What it does
🛍 One wishlist for almost any store: one click saves a product's name, price, image, size, and color from almost any retailer.
🗂 Organize your way: sort saves into collections (birthday, home, gift ideas) and add notes and tags.
🎁 Share a wishlist: send a private link to a wishlist or selected items. Recipients see only the items you share; your notes, alerts, and account stay private, and you can revoke a link anytime. (Requires a free account.)
🔔 Price drop alerts: get notified when a saved item's price falls, or when it reaches a target price you set.
📉 Price tracker with history: prices are checked for you regularly, with a history chart for every product so you can see the trend before you buy.
📦 Restock alerts: save sold-out items and get notified when they're back in stock.
🔍 Search and compare: search across everything you've saved to compare options fast.
☁ Optional private sync: create a free account to back up your wishlist and view it on any device at windowshoppings.com . Fully opt-in; skip it and everything stays on your device.
📤 Import and export: your data is yours, exportable as JSON or CSV anytime.
⭐ Optional Premium: everything above is free. WindowShoppings Premium is an optional paid subscription, bought on windowshoppings.com , that raises the limits for collaborative collections you share with other signed-in users: up to 50 collections, each with up to 1,000 items and 26 members (5, 100 and 4 on the free plan).
Some retailers block automatic checks or hide prices, so those items stay saved but may not get automatic alerts. Checks run while your browser is open.
Private by design
No ads. No selling your data. Cloud sync is off until you choose to sign in, and your saved products go only to your own private account. Optional anonymous usage counts are off by default and contain no product details or URLs.
How it works
1. Install WindowShoppings.
2. Go window shopping on your favorite store and click save when something catches your eye.
3. Add it to a wishlist, set a target price if you like, and share it when you're ready.
4. We'll alert you when the price drops or the item restocks.
Start your wishlist today and let the deals come to you.

apple-macos:6796912751.name: BookDrawer: Reading Journal
apple-macos:6796912751.description:
BookDrawer is a quiet drawer for the books you keep.
When you read them, how many times, and where they are now — all in one place.
■ Library — Want to read, reading, finished. And bought, borrowed, given away.
■ Reading history — Read it again and each pass keeps its own dates, rating, and notes.
■ Your shelf — Owned, to buy, departed (gifted, sold, lost). Two copies of one book, tracked separately.
■ Quotes — Photograph a passage and the words come across on their own. Page numbers too.
■ Reading calendar — Covers of finished books fill in the calendar, and turn into share cards for your feed.
■ iCloud sync — The same library on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No sign-in.
■ Book search — Find by title or author and pull in the cover and details. (Book data: Google Books)
No ads. Just your books.

apple-itunes:1513851259.name: The Daily Office
apple-itunes:1513851259.description:
Pray Morning, Midday, Evening, and Compline (bedtime) prayer from the Book of Common Prayer (2019), every day, wherever you are. The Daily Office sets out each office on one page, in order: no flipping between sections, no looking up readings in the lectionary, no rubrics to decode.
Join Christians around the world in the pattern of daily prayer the Church has kept since its earliest days.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Morning Prayer, Midday Prayer, Evening Prayer, and Compline for every day of the year
• Family Prayer: shorter devotions in the same pattern, for households with children
• The day's readings on their own, for Morning and Evening Prayer and the Holy Eucharist
• The whole Psalter, searchable and arranged by topic, in contemporary or traditional language
• Collects for the Christian year, the offices, and many occasions
• The Great Litany
• A calendar of the Christian year, with every feast, fast, and commemoration in its liturgical color
• Lives of the saints, with traditions and further reading for each commemoration
PRAY ANYWHERE, EVEN OFFLINE
The days ahead download on their own, up to two months of the offices, Family Prayer, and the readings for your settings, so you can pray on a plane, on retreat, or anywhere without a signal. Keep the spoken office for today and tomorrow too, and the app refreshes your downloads in the background.
PRAY ALONG WITH AUDIO
Every office can be read aloud, with each word highlighted as it is spoken. Audio keeps playing with your screen locked, and you can pause, skip, and scrub from the lock screen or your headphones.
BOOK VIEW
Pray an office one page at a time, turning the pages like a printed prayer book, with nothing else on the screen. On iPhone Duo, open it like a book and the office opens to two pages, one on each side of the fold.
PODCASTS
Prefer your podcast app? Subscribe to Morning and Evening Prayer and the daily readings, or make a podcast with your own settings.
MAKE IT YOURS
• Light, sepia, and dark themes, or follow your device
• Six typefaces, including the Caslon of the 2019 prayer book, Garamond, Baskerville, and a hyperlegible face for low vision
• Any text size, with rubrics in italic or red
• Every choice the rubrics allow: a 30- or 60-day psalter, a one- or two-year lectionary, canticles, the Traditional Language edition, and more
• Bible translations including the ESV, KJV, RSV, NASB, NIV, and NABRE
PRAY TOGETHER
Share your settings with a link or QR code, so a household, small group, or congregation can pray the same office together, in the same room or online.
FAITHFUL TO THE BOOK
The Daily Office carefully follows the text, calendar, and rubrics of the Book of Common Prayer (2019) of the Anglican Church in North America. It is an independent project, generously supported by Anglican House Publishers, publisher of the 2019 prayer book. It is not a substitute for the printed book, but a faithful companion to it: at home, at work, or on the road.
Free, with no ads and no account required. Your settings and downloads are kept on your device.
Questions, corrections, or ideas? Write to feedback@dailyoffice2019.com. We read every message.
